A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ReDeEP/AARF research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–L support a reliable comparison; the identified omissions in v2 are document changes, not extraction gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original mechanistic experiments, hallucination-detection comparisons, AARF generation evaluations, and appendix ablation and efficiency results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Table 1, Figures 4–7, and the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The ECS/PKS calculations, token- and chunk-level ReDeEP procedures, copying-head selection, and AARF interventions remain unchanged. Redrawing Figure 3 does not revise the procedures specified in Sections 3–4 and Appendices B and D.

E1.justification: Both versions use RAGTruth for QA, data-to-text writing, and news summarization, and Dolly (AC) for summarization, closed QA, and information extraction. The supplementary known-answer and hallucination scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same 16 baselines for every backbone and dataset. The unmodified-model comparators for AARF and the methods included in the efficiency comparison are unchanged.

E3.justification: Table 1 narrows reported metric coverage from AUC, PCC, accuracy, recall, and F1 to four metrics by omitting accuracy. Section 5.1 still lists accuracy, so this establishes a reporting change rather than changed experimental execution. Models, validation procedures, decoding, and tuning settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The attention/FFN interventions, known-answer analysis, attention-span diagnostic in Table 2, ECS/PKS ablations in Table 3, and efficiency analysis in Figure 7 are retained. The removed Figure 3 panels were explanatory schematics, not experimental results.

E5.justification: Figure 5's distribution plots and Appendix H's repeated-query description remain unchanged. No seed, repeated-run, confidence-interval, or significance-test reporting is added or removed.

E6.justification: v2 removes all accuracy entries from Table 1, including ReDeEP(chunk)'s 0.7889 for LLaMA2-13B on RAGTruth. Every retained AUC, PCC, recall, and F1 entry matches v1. The results in Figures 4–7 and Tables 2–3 are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A are retained, as is Appendix B's trace/Gershgorin copying-head calculation. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about hallucination mechanisms, ReDeEP's detection effectiveness, and AARF's mitigation capability. Their scientific scope and contribution claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the accurate-context scope, the qualification that ECS/PKS are approximate proxies, and the interpretations concerning excessive parametric knowledge and loss of attended information. Appendix C's copy-suppression explanation and other applicability statements are unchanged.

D1.justification: The appendices retain the same intervention procedures, annotation descriptions, evaluation prompts, hardware, hyperparameters, segmentation instructions, and model/resource links. Reflowing these disclosures does not alter reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography entries, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to hallucination detection and mechanistic interpretability are unchanged. References move across pages without substantive revision.

P1.justification: v2 removes the duplicated Yang Song entry from the author list. The body prose, headings, section order, and appendix organization otherwise remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 becomes a simpler scoring schematic and loses its attention/FFN intervention panels. Table 1 removes two accuracy columns and enlarges the remaining text, producing subsequent page reflow. Figure 3's caption and textual references still refer to the deleted panels.

improvement.justification: The simpler diagram, larger table text, and corrected author list offer modest presentation benefits. However, v2 removes accuracy results while Section 5.1 still promises that metric, and deletes Figure 3's intervention panels without updating its caption or references in Section 3.2 and Appendix D. These introduced inconsistencies and lost reporting detail produce a limited decline in completeness and usability; the underlying scientific contribution remains intact.
